latent_variables.name: Mechanism selection
latent_variables.rationale: Multiple mechanisms are implicated (Design Principles, Psychophysics / Perception). A latent variable may determine which pathway is activated.

latent_variables.name: Dose and duration
latent_variables.rationale: Most studies measure presence/absence of design multilinear octolinear rules, not dose-response curves. Duration and intensity likely matter.
latent_variables.suggested_measure: Parametric variation of intensity and exposure duration

research_needs.question: Does the effect of design multilinear octolinear rules on ratings usability replicate in a pre-registered RCT?
research_needs.rationale: Current confidence is low. A well-powered pre-registered replication would most efficiently resolve the status of this belief.

research_needs.question: Which mechanism best explains design multilinear octolinear rules → ratings usability?
research_needs.rationale: 2 candidate mechanisms exist. Process tracing would identify the active pathway.
